test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

One who does one’s work thoroughly and seriously
solution:
The correct answer is 'Conscientious'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options - 
 
 
• **Curious **- eager to know or learn something.
 
• Conscientious - wishing to do one's work or duty well and thoroughly.
 
• Conscious- aware of and responding to one's surroundings.
 
• Enthusiastic - having or showing intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that conscientious is the best word to substitute the given group of words. 
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.
